---
title: "xuloadcsv"
---

## Description

Make one dataset from a collection of raw .csv datasets.

## Parameters

**`filename`**

: Regular expression to filter the files in source directory

  *Required:* No

**`filepath`**

: Path to raw .csv datasets

  *Required:* No

**`splitchar`**

: Delimiter used in csv files

  *Required:* No

  *Default:* `$`

**`datarow`**

: Datarow option in import procedure

  *Required:* No

  *Default:* `2`

**`subjid`**

: Regular expression to parse filename and get subject id. Creates subjid_derived variable

  *Required:* No

**`visit`**

: Regular expression to parse filename and get visit. Creates visit_derived variable

  *Required:* No

**`outds`**

: Name of the output dataset

  *Required:* No

  *Default:* `out`

**`getnames`**

: Getnames option in import procedure

  *Required:* No

  *Default:* `YES`

**`compress_names`**

: Option to remove spaces from variable names

  *Required:* No

  *Default:* `Y`

**`debug`**

: Option to clean up intermediate datasets after macro execution

  *Required:* No

  *Default:* `N`

## Examples

```sas
%xuloadcsv(filename=%str(Clamp),subjid=%str(101-\d{3}),visit=%str(D\d+));
%xuloadcsv(filename=%str(^(?!.*(Dummy|PC|PK)).*csv$));
```
